steps.en: Offender picks PayNow as the payment mode
steps.id: Offender memilih PayNow sebagai cara bayar

steps.en: The system creates the PayNow transaction at the payment gateway
steps.id: Sistem membuat transaksi PayNow di payment gateway
steps.why_en: Same gap as the card flow: a failed save of the records is only logged.
steps.why_id: Celahnya sama dengan alur kartu: gagal menyimpan catatan hanya dicatat.

steps.en: The offender is sent on to the PayNow payment page
steps.id: Offender dibawa ke halaman bayar PayNow
steps.why_en: The portal only hands over to the gateway; what the next page shows cannot be seen here.
steps.why_id: Portal hanya menyerahkan ke gateway; isi halaman berikutnya tidak terlihat di sini.

steps.en: The page shows a PayNow QR code to scan or upload
steps.id: Halaman menampilkan QR PayNow untuk di-scan atau di-upload
steps.why_en: No code in the repos draws a QR code; only a static how-to guide exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code di repo yang membuat QR; hanya ada panduan gambar statis.

steps.en: The QR code stays valid for a set number of minutes
steps.id: QR code berlaku selama sekian menit
steps.why_en: No validity setting exists; the only 5-minute rule is a block on paying the same fine again.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengaturan masa berlaku; satu-satunya aturan 5 menit adalah blokir bayar ulang denda yang sama.
